culprit_citations.quoted_text: RCP Encore Acquisition, Inc. | Term Loan | 6/30/2026

findings.detail: Datacor Revolver identifier uses 3/13 with the current year, while the current source row states 3/11/2030 and the comparative row states 3/13/2029.
RCP Encore identifier uses the comparative maturity 3/31/2026 instead of the current source maturity 6/30/2026.

rationale: Class 2 review of the full source rows resolves which field is wrong. The current filing schedule states 3/11/2030 for the Datacor Revolver at table 13 row 8 and 6/30/2026 for the RCP Encore Term Loan at table 20 row 19, matching the structured XBRL dates and contradicting the identifier dates. Comparative rows explain the leaked date components: Datacor is 3/13/2029 at table 31 row 7, and RCP Encore is 3/31/2026 at table 37 row 36. Thus the identifier-generation path leaked comparative maturity data; the structured maturity values are correct.
